candidates.question: Perturbation-defined plan granularity
candidates.presealed_mechanism: A perturbation that preserves versus destroys a solver's subgoal boundary changes local repair topology and latency after state distance and motor interruption are matched.
candidates.fatal_rival: State distance, surprise, elapsed time, generic motor interruption, or an algorithm restart fully explains the contrast.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: 2x2 boundary-preserved/destroyed × matched perturbation topology; preregister repair latency, replanned route, and local/global continuation with a motor-only control.

candidates.question: Longitudinal microstructure of skill acquisition
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Skill improvement contains discrete recognition/uncertainty/chunk transitions rather than only a smooth practice-speed curve.
candidates.fatal_rival: Practice amount, baseline ability, fixed method, or motor speeding accounts for every apparent transition.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Longitudinal exact-state/move/latency records, preregistered change-point rule, held-out transfer, and matched-practice/motor controls.

candidates.question: Frame remapping versus action-coordinate remapping versus plan continuity
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Physical-frame transformation, action-coordinate relabeling, and disruption of plan continuity have separable performance signatures in the same task.
candidates.fatal_rival: Generic mental rotation, familiarity, motor remapping, or plan-memory loss explains all effects.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Factorial physical switch × label remap × plan continuity, with a no-remap spatial-switch control and preregistered dissociation pattern.

candidates.question: Human-optimal search objective gap
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Skilled non-shortest routes minimize an objective including recognition, uncertainty, retrieval, motor cost, risk, or future recognizability.
candidates.fatal_rival: Knowledge gaps, method constraints, motor limits, or a planner-irrelevant route convention explain route choice.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: State pairs whose candidate objectives rank routes differently, with explicit knowledge/repertoire and motor controls.

candidates.question: Structural transfer versus algorithm memorization
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Transfer is carried by structural knowledge rather than named algorithms, chunks, or generic practice.
candidates.fatal_rival: Difficulty, overlap, spatial ability, training order, or algorithm repertoire accounts for transfer.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Transfer matrix crossing surface and structural overlap with repertoire and baseline controls.

candidates.question: State-matched action hysteresis
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Matched current state retains a causal action-history bias.
candidates.fatal_rival: Motor, visual, subgoal, or incomplete-state matching explains the effect.
prior_art_read: Action history influences subsequent movement, DOI 10.7554/eLife.26713
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Exact-state matched histories with motor/visual/subgoal controls.

candidates.question: Collective algorithm innovation
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Population dissemination and adoption, not only individual improvement, shapes algorithm innovation.
candidates.fatal_rival: Selection, hardware, format, practice, and survival bias explain apparent collective change.
prior_art_read: Krakauer, Kardeş & Grochow 2025, Universality in Collective Intelligence on the Rubik's Cube, arXiv:2511.18609
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Time-indexed dissemination with predeclared adoption, selection, hardware, and format controls.

candidates.question: Blindfold versus sighted solving
candidates.presealed_mechanism: Blindfold and sighted solving separate state estimation, memory, retrieval, motor execution, and algorithm use.
candidates.fatal_rival: Population, repertoire, event-format, and aggregate-time differences explain the comparison.
candidates.prospective_discriminator: Within-solver matched repertoire protocol separating memorization, execution, and retrieval with event-format controls.

selection_basis: Each retains independent scientific importance, at least two presealed rival mechanisms, a prospective intervention discriminator, and no G3-tombstone revival; order is not a launch authorization.
